description: Clio payments in a date window: online (Clio Payments) with state, incl. failed and not yet linked to a client, and payments recorded on bills, incl. plan charges. needs_attention flags them. Read-only. Sign-in required.

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to 6 days before to.

limit.description: Max payments listed per source, newest first, 1-100. Defaults to 50. Counts cover the whole window.

source.description: online: Clio Payments with their state. recorded: payments recorded on bills. Defaults to all.

state.description: Only online payments in this state.

unlinked_only.description: Only online payments not yet linked to a client in Clio.

name: list_payments
title: List payments
